recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit as-is. Future work is only needed if Patient Care reopens the datatype/binding model in a later issue.
issue_request: FHIR-17743 was Published/Persuasive and requested changing AllergyIntolerance.clinicalStatus and AllergyIntolerance.verificationStatus from code to CodeableConcept, consistent with Condition, while preserving required bindings to AllergyIntolerance status value sets.
initial_application: The request was explicitly applied by db4dbacb2d3c, which changed the AllergyIntolerance spreadsheet datatypes from code to CodeableConcept, converted examples to CodeableConcept coding form, added GF#17743 committee notes, and changed status bindings from inline code lists to value-set-backed required bindings. Later source refactoring preserved this in structuredefinition-AllergyIntolerance.xml.
additional_context: AllergyIntolerance is active in source/fhir.ini and assigned to Patient Care. Condition clinicalStatus and verificationStatus also remain CodeableConcept, satisfying the requested alignment. FHIR-19633 and the #committers Zulip discussion explain why CodeableConcept with required bindings was retained for status nuances; FHIR-23008 handled later invariant fallout without reversing the datatype change. No conflicting Confluence or Zulip evidence was found for FHIR-17743.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Current source/allergyintolerance/structuredefinition-AllergyIntolerance.xml defines both status elements as CodeableConcept with required bindings to the AllergyIntolerance clinical and verification value sets; examples and the checked diagram are also already aligned.

related_jiras.note: Added explanatory comments for why AllergyIntolerance and Condition status elements are CodeableConcept after FHIR-17743/GF#16193.
Addressed broken AllergyIntolerance/Condition invariants caused by treating CodeableConcept verificationStatus like code, but did not reverse FHIR-17743.
